summary_en: 500,000 shares (0.93% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥1.5B upper limit, open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange, Aug 10 – Oct 30, 2026. Purpose: treasury for restricted-stock award plan and future capital policy flexibility. Note: 3-for-1 stock split effective Oct 1, 2026 will convert limit to 1.5M shares post-split.
title_en: Notice of determination of matters relating to acquisition of treasury shares
translation_en_brief:
RaizNext Corporation announced on 7 August 2026 a treasury share acquisition programme decided by the board the same day. The company will acquire up to 500,000 ordinary shares representing 0.93% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury, 54,008,244 shares as of 31 March 2026) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥1.5 billion via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition window runs from 10 August to 30 October 2026.

The stated purpose is twofold: to provide shares for allocation under the company's restricted-stock award incentive plan, and to enable flexible future capital policy execution. A material note: the company announced on 30 July 2026 a 3-for-1 stock split effective 1 October 2026, and the acquisition limit will be reinterpreted post-split as 1.5 million shares (reflecting the split factor).
